_: Import points (lane 2.9b-c3; owner call 2.9b): goods with no Black Marsh source are bought only where they come in from outside the province. `importOnly` items (ids as on the shelf, no `item.` prefix) are never shelved elsewhere; at each point they join every trader's shelf at the favour weight. Every other way to get one is loot. Read by worldgen.trade_tables into packages/economy/src/data/stock-tables.json.

importOnly.why: Dwemer metal is salvaged from Dwemer ruins; none stands in Black Marsh, so traders bring the metal from outside the province.
Moonstone is an Altmer and Bosmer working stone; no lore places a Black Marsh source.
Orichalcum is Orsimer ore; no lore places a Black Marsh source.
Malachite (glass) is mined in Morrowind and the Summerset Isles, never in the marsh.
Ebony comes from Morrowind and Skyrim; in the marsh it is imported and costly.

points.why: Lilmoth's lighter crews carry every cargo ashore from the deep-water hulls anchored in the Southern Sea, so foreign metal passes through their hands first.
Chasepoint's salvage families take what the Southern Sea wrecks wash ashore, on the coast road beside Soulrest, the port that draws in foreign goods.
Claywater Station is an Imperial road station on the way in from Cyrodiil by the Blackwood Road, where traders from outside the province stop first.
